findings.subject: search-field
findings.summary: Contract slot search-field-input is never rendered; the input carries data-slot='input'.
findings.fix: Pass data-slot='search-field-input' to InputGroupInput (Input already lets props override fieldProps) and add a slot test.

findings.subject: field
findings.summary: Field's invalid and disabled states have no typed prop; invalid needs data-invalid='true' on Field, invalid on the control and a FieldError, and a FieldError alone flips aria-invalid without the red chrome.
findings.fix: Add invalid/disabled props to Field that set data-invalid/data-disabled and share them through FieldContext, and let Input/Textarea/SelectTrigger/AutocompleteInput read that context (or style .a63-Input:has([aria-invalid='true'])).

findings.subject: field
findings.summary: Docs give no way to learn the three-signal invalid wiring.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 component field` (no invalid example); field.stories.tsx:41-52
findings.fix: Document the invalid pattern in the guidance with a runnable example (or remove the need via the K1 fix).

findings.subject: input, textarea, input-otp, search-field, autocomplete, select
findings.summary: Field controls stay 32px on coarse pointers with the web design language; none expands to the 44px target input.json declares.
findings.evidence: packages/styles/src/contracts/environment.css:128-139 sets --a63-control-min-size 2rem (32px) on pointer:coarse and --a63-control-min-target 2.75rem, but no field recipe reads min-target (grep min-target in input/textarea/input-otp/autocomplete/select css: 0 hits; button.css:130-137 uses a ::before target). input.json:107-110 declares web minHitTarget.touch 44. Only designLanguage=ios / form-factor=phone raise md to 44px (environment.css:165-170, 201-244; apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-select-endpoints-chromium-linux.png iOS touch row).
findings.fix: Floor field height with --a63-control-min-target on coarse pointers (fields cannot use a ::before tap target the way Button does, since the box itself is the target), or document a 32px touch exception in the contract and ask YZ.

findings.subject: input, textarea, search-field, input-otp, autocomplete
findings.summary: Focus-visible (and for input-otp the contract's 'current' slot) is captured in no baseline.
findings.evidence: No story captures focus-visible or hover (no play functions in the batch's stories; visual/commands.ts parks the pointer so nothing hovers). Baselines listed under each subject's K4.
findings.fix: Add a focused-state story per field (play function focusing the control) to the visual baselines.

findings.subject: input
findings.summary: Autofill is promised as a designed state but no autofill rule exists.
findings.evidence: apps/docs/src/pages/component-input.mdx:75; grep autofill over packages/styles/src and packages/ui-react/src CSS: 0 hits
findings.fix: Add :autofill / :-webkit-autofill styling on .a63-Input-field (inset box-shadow in --field-background, -webkit-text-fill-color text-primary) and a baseline, or delete the claim.

findings.subject: input, textarea, search-field, autocomplete, select

findings.evidence: Terminal light: --a63-text-tertiary = color-mix(action-primary 80%, black) vs --a63-text-primary = color-mix(action-primary 70%, black) (`atom63 token --a63-text-tertiary`), so placeholder reads as a typed value: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-input-themes-chromium-linux.png terminal/light 'Search…' vs 'focused-look', apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-field-themes-chromium-linux.png terminal/light.
findings.fix: Raise the contrast gap between terminal --a63-text-tertiary and --a63-text-primary in light mode (Layer 1 token) while keeping placeholder >=4.5:1; confirm on the contact sheet.

findings.subject: select
findings.summary: Base UI Select 1.6.0 deviates from APG select-only combobox in five documented ways (focus model, Home/End, Alt+Up, Tab).
findings.fix: File the drafted upstream issues and patch what can be patched locally (Tab selecting the highlighted option, Home/End opening) in SelectTrigger/SelectPopup key handlers; keep the knownGaps list in sync.

findings.summary: No phone-width story with the popup open, so keyboard overlap and safe-area placement of the listbox are unverified.
findings.evidence: select.stories.tsx and autocomplete.stories.tsx: no viewport/phone story; select.tsx:79 alignItemWithTrigger=true
findings.fix: Add phone (390px) stories with the popup open, including an autocomplete with the on-screen keyboard area simulated, to the visual baselines.

findings.subject: search-field
findings.summary: The contract-required 'query' state (value plus clear button) and invalid are never captured.
findings.fix: Add a Query story with defaultValue and an Invalid story to the baselines.

findings.subject: search-field
findings.summary: No Themes story, so aqua/retro/terminal are never captured for SearchField.
findings.fix: Add a 4×2 Themes story like input.stories.tsx:320.

findings.subject: input-otp
findings.summary: OTP slots mirror in RTL documents, so a typed code reads reversed.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/input-otp/input-otp.css:11-15 (no direction); input-otp@1.4.2 dist sets no direction
findings.fix: Set direction: ltr (or dir='ltr') on .a63-InputOTP, as codes are LTR, and add an RTL story.

findings.subject: input-otp
findings.summary: OTP slots are 32px squares on coarse web pointers.
findings.fix: Covered by the field touch-target fix; slot size should floor at --a63-control-min-target on coarse pointers.

findings.subject: form
findings.summary: The canonical Form example overrides the visible label with aria-label, teaching a label-in-name failure.
findings.fix: Remove aria-label from the Input inside FormControl in every Form story (FormLabel already names it).

findings.subject: form
findings.summary: Form has two behaviour tests; message-without-error, missing description and context-error paths are untested.
findings.fix: Add tests for FormMessage children with no error, aria-describedby without FormDescription, and useFormField outside FormField/FormItem.

findings.subject: form
findings.summary: FormControl's aria-describedby names a description id even when no FormDescription renders, and FormMessage combines role=alert with aria-live=polite.
findings.fix: Only include ids of parts that render (register like Field does) and drop aria-live (role=alert implies assertive) or use role=status.

findings.subject: amount
findings.summary: Amount without locale formats with the runtime locale, so server and browser output differ and hydration mismatches; the default path is untested.
findings.fix: Make locale required, or default to a fixed locale from UIProvider, and add a hydration test with differing locales.

findings.subject: field
findings.summary: The contract-required disabled state of Field is not captured in any story.
findings.fix: Add a Disabled story to the baselines.

findings.subject: input, textarea, input-otp
findings.summary: No forced-colors rules: the invalid state (border colour only) and the OTP fake caret (background-color) vanish in forced colours.
findings.evidence: input.css:138-146; textarea.css:81-85; input-otp.css:101-106; craft-baseline.json token-role input-otp entry; 13 other recipes have forced-colors blocks
findings.fix: Add @media (forced-colors: active) rules: a thicker or dashed border for [data-invalid] and background: CanvasText for the caret.

findings.subject: input-otp
findings.summary: Slot emits data-active while the contract state is 'current'; no invalid prop and no exported prop types.
findings.fix: Emit data-current (keep data-active one release), add invalid like Input, export InputOTPProps/InputOTPSlotProps.

findings.subject: input, textarea, search-field, field
findings.summary: States named 'focus' and 'default' are baselined synonyms of focus-visible and rest.
findings.fix: Rename the contract states and drop the baseline entries.

findings.subject: input
findings.summary: unstyled and shadow are boolean chrome modifiers beside the variant axis.
findings.fix: Consider a chrome value (e.g. variant 'none') for unstyled and folding shadow into the variants; low priority.

findings.subject: select
findings.summary: select.mdx claims the trigger resolves a minimum target from the control ramp; select.css never reads one.
findings.fix: Correct the doc or implement the target (see the K5 finding).

findings.subject: textarea
findings.summary: Textarea has no variant axis although Input and InputGroupTextarea expose default/filled/plain.
findings.fix: Decide whether textarea takes the field variants; if yes add them to textarea.json and the recipe.

findings.subject: autocomplete
findings.summary: startAddon is always aria-hidden and the clear name API differs from SearchField's clearLabel.
findings.fix: Only hide decorative addons (or document that startAddon must be decorative); align on one clear-label API.

findings.subject: amount
findings.summary: strong is a weight axis not listed in the amount contract.
findings.fix: Add a weights list to amount.json or document strong as an extension prop.

findings.subject: amount
findings.summary: Themes baseline rows are unlabelled and terminal keeps the proportional face.
findings.fix: Label the rows; decide whether terminal draws amounts in its mono face.

findings.subject: label
findings.summary: Label dims when any later sibling is disabled, not only its own control.
findings.fix: Scope the :has() to the associated control (e.g. :has(+ :disabled)) or rely on group data-disabled only.

findings.subject: input, textarea, input-otp, search-field, autocomplete, select, field, form, label
findings.summary: Generated docs carry a reviewer checklist line as builder guidance.
findings.evidence: `atom63 component <slug>` Guidance: 'Validate focus visibility, disabled state, invalid state, and touch input together.'
findings.fix: Replace with per-component usage guidance or drop the line.
